article_context: Body image placed after the section on support for delayed return flights and before an alternative route to the mountains. It reinforces that an unexpected delay can still leave guests comfortable, relaxed, and able to enjoy their stay at the resort.
image_reading: A smiling couple in white bathrobes stands together on a hotel balcony, with the man holding a coffee cup and pointing toward the mountain view.
The mountain landscape remains clearly visible behind them; their relaxed posture and breakfast setting convey a calm resort stay.

models.positive_prompt: The man slowly completes a gentle pointing gesture toward the mountains while both guests keep smiling and looking at the view; fixed camera. In the final frame, his hand rests in a clear point and the couple remains relaxed together on the balcony.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the man’s already raised hand makes one calm, moderate forward-and-outward pointing motion toward the mountain vista. The woman stays beside him with her cup, and both maintain their warm, relaxed smiles and shared attention on the view. Keep the camera fixed so the balcony and mountains remain legible; the gesture settles naturally near the end.

models.positive_prompt: The man gradually extends his pointing hand toward the mountain vista as the couple share the view with relaxed smiles. Fixed camera; by the end, the gesture is fully settled and both remain comfortably together on the balcony.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, let the man smoothly finish a single unhurried pointing gesture toward the mountains. The couple’s attention stays on the vista throughout, with a small natural shift of posture as the gesture develops. Hold a fixed composition to preserve the sense of a calm hotel balcony; reach the settled pointing pose close to the last frames.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the couple as the man gently finishes pointing toward the mountains; both keep relaxed smiles and their gaze on the view. The final frame holds his clear pointing gesture and their calm shared moment on the balcony.
models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, use a compact, even motion: the man completes one gentle pointing extension toward the mountain view while the woman remains relaxed beside him with the cup. Their gaze stays directed outward and their smiles remain warm. The fixed camera keeps the landscape and both people visible, ending as the hand settles into the pointing position.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Even when travel plans are disrupted, the resort can preserve a calm and enjoyable holiday stay.
structured_intent.primary_action: The man completes a gentle pointing gesture toward the mountain view while the couple shares the vista.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The couple remains relaxed, welcomed, and content at the resort throughout.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The man’s hand is settled in a clear point toward the mountains, with both guests smiling and looking outward together.
